profit_question: Can I leave the protocol with bad debt while I leave with good assets?

ruled_out_vectors.reason: _collectToken (AMMModule.sol:2913-2920) enforces strict balance check: balance_after == balance_before + amount. FOT tokens always revert.
_transferHookFeesByHook follows CEI: storage.tokensOwed[key] decremented before safeTransfer. Even with flags cleared at line 3190, double-spend prevented by underflow check.
_poolSwapByInput updates reserves (lines 1435-1443) before _finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse transfers tokens. VIEW calls during transfer see committed state.
beforeSwap always overwrites DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT. Second swap in same TX sees its own write, not first swap's value.
setTokenSettings requires nonReentrant modifier. Cannot change settings mid-swap. Hooks read fresh settings per-call.
TstorishReentrancyGuardWithFlags blocks all state-changing reentry during swap. MaliciousToken callback cannot corrupt pool state.
Constant-product x*y=k with fee deduction. Round trip always loses fees. Fuzz tested with 25 random amounts.
Flash loan balance check + swap fees prevent net profit. Both direct and via-pool-swap paths tested.
SqrtPriceMath rounds UP for input, DOWN for output — protocol always benefits. 100 1-wei swaps confirmed no pool loss.
CEI pattern: storage decremented before transfer. Hash-isolated per (owner,token). Underflow check prevents over-withdrawal.
Direct token transfers to AMM create surplus (balance > reserves), not deficit. Swap uses cached reserve state, not balanceOf.
Fees prevent profitable round-trips across pools. Each pool independently solvent after cross-pool operations.
setProtocolFees only affects future swaps. No pending state can be manipulated for extraction.
Reserves updated atomically. _collectToken balance check prevents phantom liquidity.
Self-consistent: tokenFor==tokenFee in all 8 callers. At worst causes fund-lock for hooks misusing the interface.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Fee accumulator overflow via extreme swaps
ruled_out_vectors.reason: uint128 fee balances with _safeIncrementUint128 overflow check. 30 large swaps confirmed no overflow.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Rounding asymmetry in add vs remove liquidity
ruled_out_vectors.reason: SqrtPriceMath.getAmount0Delta/getAmount1Delta: positive liquidityChange (add) rounds UP, negative (remove) rounds DOWN. Protocol always net positive.
Flash loan fees stored in protocolFees mapping, NOT in pool feeBalance. Separate accounting prevents inflation of LP-claimable fees.

summary: No exploitable insolvency vectors found. The protocol employs robust defenses: strict balance checks reject fee-on-transfer tokens, CEI pattern prevents reentrancy-based double-spend, transient storage is overwritten per-swap, and rounding always favors the protocol. 18 vectors systematically ruled out with 75 passing Forge tests including 5 fuzz campaigns.
